ideas.name: Energy Text Optimizer
ideas.problem: Generative AI models consume significant energy, especially with non-English text. This tool helps optimize prompts and outputs for different languages to reduce computational load and energy consumption for developers and businesses using AI.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B, tiered pricing based on API usage (e.g., $29/month for up to 1000 optimizations).
